description: This Java source file defines the DebugAnyApplication class, which extends the base application class for the AnySoftKeyboard project. It customizes crash handling and adds a watermark drawable for debug builds.

classes.name: DebugAnyApplication
classes.description: A subclass of AnyApplication that sets up crash handling with logging and strict mode, and adds a debug watermark to the application's initial watermarks list.

methods.name: setupCrashHandler
methods.description: Overrides the base method to set a custom log provider and enable strict mode policies if enabled in preferences.

methods.name: getInitialWatermarksList
methods.description: Overrides the base method to add a debug watermark drawable to the list of watermarks.
